method: Independent arithmetic simulation of every integer-second collector/browser phase offset over one hour. Each read resolves the most recent published capture as of request start. Ten seconds publication delay and ten seconds read delay are assumed. Not a production-helper rerun or uptime guarantee.
limitations: Assumes the active worker succeeds on cadence. Source outages, long captures, worker handoffs, browser suspension and transport/API failures can still expire prices.
No probability, EV, role, model or five-minute eligibility changes.
